The '''Battle of the Xa Fel system''' was a battle fought during the [[Fifth Alsakan Conflict]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Alsakan/Legends|Alsakan]] near the Alsakan-controlled [[Xa Fel system/Legends|Xa Fel system]].<ref name="TEGtW" />
